summary: Short kerb where cars park, but homes 14-15 m behind on its own side.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-19 m away on the north side and 18 m across the road; homes close all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along both kerbs; 16 m is enough for one van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Slope about 3%, at the steep threshold
Signed 2P daytime weekdays, resident permits excepted
sun_shade: Large tree on the north side shades the western end; otherwise open.

best_section.where: North kerb of Montrose Road by the large building and its car park
